evidence.title: World Map visual for React & shadcn/ui - CodedVisuals

name: World Map
summary: Animated dotted world map visual for React and shadcn/ui that blooms from a chosen city with markers, regions and connection arcs.
description: A coded visual composition from the CodedVisuals library: a dotted world map that blooms outward from a chosen city, with pinging location markers, tinted coverage regions and connection arcs that draw between cities. Variations include labels, reveal styles, region density, custom markers and colors; it installs as a single React + TypeScript file through the shadcn registry and is themed with shadcn/ui tokens.
contains: dotted world map that blooms outward from a chosen city
pinging location markers, tinted coverage regions and connection arcs between cities
variations: labels, split and sweep reveals, sparse or dense regions, custom markers and colors
single-file React + TypeScript composition animated with Motion, themed with shadcn/ui tokens
installs through the shadcn registry or copy-paste; log in to copy
part of CodedVisuals: 122 visuals and 1150+ variations; $69 one-time Solo license
